stories.title: 2 Indiana men charged in $600 million Ponzi scheme
stories.summary: Both men were arrested on Wednesday for allegedly luring over 2,000 investors with extraordinary returns while diverting hundreds of millions of dollars.

stories.title: Salvation Army kicks off annual 'Red Kettle Campaign' in Indianapolis
stories.summary: For more than 100 years, the Salvation Army has used the campaign to help Hoosiers in need by providing food, housing, youth programs, and other essential services.

stories.title: Flood relief organizers see growing need for assistance, hope for deadline extension
stories.summary: After reaching out to hundreds of Marion County residents, flood relief organizers hope the state will give families more time to apply for financial assistance.

stories.title: Federal commission approves sale of AES to investment organizations
stories.summary: The federal commission approved the acquisition, which was led by Global Infrastructure Partners, a part of BlackRock and the EQT Infrastructure VI fund.

stories.title: 'Christmas at the Zoo' returns to Indianapolis Nov. 21
stories.summary: Since 1967, Christmas at the Zoo has been a holiday favorite for Hoosiers across the city.

stories.title: Bayh adds secretary of state campaign rival to transition team
stories.summary: Beau Bayh says outgoing Republican Diego Morales has cooperated so far ahead of office handover in the two weeks since his election victory.

stories.title: Indianapolis man arrested in Fishers for allegedly spitting on people along Nickel Plate Trail
stories.summary: The man was arrested on Nov. 18 and is facing charges of two counts of battery by bodily waste after allegedly spitting on people in September.

stories.title: Muncie fires longtime firefighter, citing multiple incidents of misconduct
stories.summary: The Muncie Fire Merit Commission announced it terminated the employment of Capt. Troy Dulaney after finding he violated city and fire department rules.

stories.title: 1 dead, 2 critically hurt in crash on southeast side of Indianapolis
stories.summary: According to IMPD, the crash happened just before 10:30 a.m. at South Emerson Avenue and Shelbyville Road.

stories.title: 'We tend to see people as family ' | Longtime downtown pizzeria plans to close
stories.summary: Giorgio's Pizza's co-owner said the decision mainly came down to a lease agreement, but other factors weighed in as well.

stories.title: Exclusive: ACLU of Indiana names new interim legal director as internal investigation continues
stories.summary: Lauren Robel will oversee the ACLU's legal work to protect rights for Hoosiers after staff shakeup.

stories.title: City of Muncie and AFSCME Union declare impasse in contract negotiations
stories.summary: Muncie has officially declared an impasse in negotiations with the American Federation of State, County, and Municipal Employees.
